lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are organized into approximately four horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns, creating a geometric grid across the mid-flank posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs at near 90-degree angles to form the anchor nodes of the primary pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct linear carinae run horizontally across the lateral flank. Each features a sharp vertical luminance shift, with a high-intensity leading edge and a low-intensity shadow immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 10 high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the lower two-thirds of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, slender objects with elongated silhouettes (remoras) are visible attached to the ventral surface of the pectoral fin.
